title: Pre-flight framing respects saved corrections and memory visibility policy
prompt: Save an Atlas verification command, correct it, and save a human-review requirement. Frame a verification task before execution, then repeat with memory disabled.

assertions.requiredBehavior: Pre-flight receives policy-filtered L0, repository, and relevant memory through the shared builder, preserving source/review warnings and attribution. Disabled, no-memory, group/public, verifier, and default sub-agent contexts do not retrieve personal memory. Missing context must not be described as proof that no prior memory or agreement exists.
assertions.failureBehavior: If policy resolution fails, skip pre-flight framing and continue execution without making an ungrounded framing call.

notes: Traceability specification for the executable regressions, not a model-generated task-success score. Live runtime acceptance must independently verify terminal status, actual file writes, and memory exclusion; executor turn limits must allow pre-flight, planning, execution, and verification.
